articles.title: Supercell launches GTA VI-inspired Brawl Vice season for Brawl Stars
articles.summary: Supercell has launched Brawl Vice, a new season for Brawl Stars, that appears to draw inspiration from GTA VI, alongside a major ranked overhaul and new characters. The company rolled out the update following a maintenance break on November 3rd, with Season 56: Brawl Vice officially launching on…
body: Called Brawl Vice, the new season introduces a collection of themed skins, including Brawl Vice Bull, Crime Pays Poco, Undercover Buzz, Undercover Pierce and Black Market Barley.
City Streets Bull, City Days Emz and City Nights Emz are also part of the season's offerings. The update also brings new Brawlers, Thunder Frogs and Rey, alongside Rey's partner Ruby.
Thunder Frogs is a Legendary artillery character, while Rey and Ruby are Mythic Brawlers with abilities designed to work together.

Supercell is also making major changes to Ranked, including raising its unlock requirement from 1,000 to 5,000 Trophies. Players will now need Power 11 Brawlers at every rank, while the Diamond rank requirement increases from nine to 12 Brawlers.
